verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh lets an agent run its screening pipeline through a documented API. It can create and screen customers synchronously, asynchronously or in batch, receive outcomes via WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks, and retrieve cases, alerts and screening results through the API. It can also set ongoing-monitoring configuration and status per customer. API credentials carry configurable permissions and expiry, and a published OpenAPI schema plus llms.txt support agent integration. However, this is AML screening rather than identity-document verification sessions, and there is no MCP surface or explicit on-demand re-check endpoint. Missing for 10: MCP server, IDV-style session and extracted-document-data retrieval, explicit polling/re-screen endpoint, hands-on corroboration of agent-operated workflows.
